name: Full check before task completion
oneLine: Blocks Claude from marking a task completed while your project check fails.
description: Fires on TaskCompleted. The script runs your project's check command (tests, lint, build - you pick) and exits 2 with the output when it fails; Claude gets the failure as a tool error and keeps working. Schema note: TaskCompleted decision behavior is one of the newer event semantics - verify against your Claude Code version before relying on it, which is why this hook ships as needs-manual-check.
scriptBody:
#!/bin/bash
# full-check-before-complete: run the project check; block completion on failure.
# Set HOOKBOOK_CHECK_CMD to your project check (default: npm test).
set -u
cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" || exit 0
check="${HOOKBOOK_CHECK_CMD:-npm test}"
if ! $check >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Project check failed ($check) - task is not done:" >&2
  $check 2>&1 | tail -30 >&2
  exit 2
fi
exit 0

parameters.label: Check command
parameters.description: Command that must pass before a task can complete (set as HOOKBOOK_CHECK_CMD in the script).

recoveryNote: The block only tells Claude the check failed, with output - it fixes and retries. To unblock yourself, fix the failure or remove the hook entry.
installSteps: Save the script to .claude/hooks/full-check-before-complete.sh and chmod +x it.
Edit the HOOKBOOK_CHECK_CMD default at the top of the script to your real check (npm test, make check, pytest...), or export HOOKBOOK_CHECK_CMD via the env key in settings.json.
Add the config fragment to .claude/settings.json, then run the manual test below before trusting it - TaskCompleted semantics are version-sensitive.
testSteps: Positive: break the build, ask Claude to complete a task - completion must be blocked with the check output shown to Claude.
Negative: with the check green, task completion proceeds normally.
verifiedAgainst: Claude Code hooks reference, event/matcher schema checked 2026-09-10
seoTitle: Full check before task completion - Claude Code hook
seoDescription: A TaskCompleted hook that blocks completion while the project check fails.
